psychological_meaning: Kumera, a warm and earthy brown, evokes feelings of stability, comfort, and connection to the earth. It is often associated with reliability, resilience, and resourcefulness. This color can also represent a sense of history, tradition, and groundedness, promoting a feeling of security and warmth.
